chunks: And al-Shaykh—may Allah, the Exalted, support him—informed me, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the ghusl on Friday, and he said: “It is obligatory upon every male and female, whether slave or free.”
ai.seo_question: Is Friday ghusl obligatory for every man and woman in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling of Friday ghusl in emphatic legal language, describing it as obligatory for all adult persons without distinction between male and female or slave and free. Its significance lies in showing the broad scope and importance of this ritual purification in connection with Friday observance.
